title: When the Silence Sings
author: Ivo Galloway
blurb: Isandro Amberdale, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
